$comment: Streaming engine via the generic WebSocket adapter. Parameters from AssemblyAI's streaming API reference (checked 2026-10-12). Universal-3.6 Pro Realtime supports 32 languages including Urdu, with native code-switching. Languages are sent as language_codes; with none set the model auto-detects. Turn-detection-off variant: end_of_turn_confidence_threshold=1 and max_turn_silence=10000 so the server does not end turns at short pauses; ForceEndpoint then Terminate at the end of the audio.
label: AssemblyAI Universal-3.6 Pro (turn detection off)
